summary: vanexa-agent daemon exposes remote shell execution via author-controlled WebSocket relay
details: The daemon opens a persistent WebSocket connection to wss://vanexa-agent-relay.hanazaki542.workers.dev and processes messages from that relay. On a 'task_request' message the supplied task text is fed to an agent loop whose tool registry exposes a 'terminal.exec' tool that spawns /bin/bash -c <command> (cmd.exe /c on Windows) on the host running the daemon, giving the relay operator arbitrary shell execution on the installer's machine. A separate 'config_update' message applies attacker-supplied fields to the running agent, including sandbox.grantAllAccess, which disables the local approval gate that would otherwise prompt before destructive tool calls. The relay endpoint is a hardcoded author-controlled Cloudflare Workers host; the installer never configures it. The bundled dist/bundle.js also contains curl invocations reachable from the same tool surface.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
